title: Pulse Compression Library
text: 脉冲压缩规格库，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；{Signal propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Specification of each waveform in the library} 指定库中脉冲波形的规格、{Pulse compression specifications} 指定脉冲压缩的类型、{Inherit sample rate} 指定从上游模块继承采样率、{Sample rate (Hz)} 指定信号采样率 1e6、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入信号 complex-valued K -by- L matrix | complex-valued K -by- N matrix | complex-valued K -by- N -by- L array

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: 处理规格的索引 positive integer

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 输出信号 complex-valued K -by- L matrix | complex-valued K -by- N matrix | complex-valued K -by- N -by- L array

ports.name: Range
ports.summary: 采样距离 real-valued length- M vector

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Specification of each waveform in the library
params.values: 库中脉冲波形的规格 {{’Rectangular’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6},{’LinearFM’,’PRF’,1e4,’PulseWidth’,50e-6,’SweepBandwidth’,1e5,’SweepDirection’,’Up’,’SweepInterval’,’Positive’}} (default) | cell array

params.name: Pulse compression specifications
params.values: 指定脉冲压缩的类型 {{’MatchedFilter’,’SpectrumWindow’,’None’},{’StretchProcessor’,’RangeSpan’,200,’ReferenceRange’,5e3,’RangeWindow’,’None’}} (default) | cell array

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: 从上游模块继承采样率 on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 信号采样率 1e6 (default) | positive real-valued scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
